"""Frozen real-API diagnostic on a growing copy, not exact-1M release acceptance."""
import argparse,cProfile,hashlib,json,math,pstats,sqlite3,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--source',required=True);parser.add_argument('--label',required=True);parser.add_argument('--output',required=True);parser.add_argument('--profile',action='store_true')
args=parser.parse_args();sys.path.insert(0,args.source)
from commontrace import fact_store as fs,hierarchical as h
from benchmarks.next_generation_storage import items,statement
root=Path('/tmp/commontrace-p0-million-tuning-root').read_text().strip();index_path=Path('/tmp/commontrace-p0-million-tuning-next-index');start=int(index_path.read_text())
assert all(module.__file__.startswith(args.source+'/') for module in (fs,h))
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=args.source)
names=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','-z'],cwd=args.source).decode().split('\0')
hashes={name:hashlib.sha256((Path(args.source)/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in names if name and (Path(args.source)/name).is_file()}
report={'scope':__doc__,'limitations':['Growing mutable million-copy with concurrent validation load; sequential ABBA runs are not a controlled causal experiment.','Full local/server hybrid, real-model quality and zero-document-reembedding restart not measured.'],'source_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=args.source,text=True).strip(),'source_files_sha256':hashes,'source_root':args.source,'command':sys.argv,'python':sys.version,'root':root,'label':args.label,'started_at_unix':time.time()}
def count():
 with sqlite3.connect(fs.database_path(root)) as connection:return {table:connection.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM '+table).fetchone()[0] for table in ('facts','events','lexicon','postings')}
def advance(count):
 global start
 start+=count;index_path.write_text(str(start))
report['before']=count()
t=time.perf_counter();warm=h.add_facts(root,items(start,1000));report['warmup_seconds']=time.perf_counter()-t
assert len(warm)==1000 and all(action=='ADD' for _,action in warm);advance(1000)
report['facts_before_timed_batch']=report['before']['facts']+1000
batch=items(start,1000);t=time.perf_counter();admitted=h.add_facts(root,batch);elapsed=time.perf_counter()-t
assert len(admitted)==1000 and all(action=='ADD' for _,action in admitted);advance(1000)
report['batch']={'size':1000,'elapsed_seconds':elapsed,'facts_per_second':1000/elapsed}
with fs.transaction(root) as facts:
 assert facts.connection.execute("SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key='near_postings'").fetchone()==('global-v2',)
 assert facts.connection.execute("SELECT 1 FROM lexicon WHERE kind>='near:' AND kind<'near;' LIMIT 1").fetchone() is None
 for fact,action in admitted:
  expected=h._content(h._signature(fact.statement)[0])
  actual=frozenset(row[0] for row in facts.connection.execute("SELECT l.term FROM lexicon l JOIN postings p ON p.term_id=l.id JOIN facts f ON f.rowid=p.fact_row WHERE f.id=? AND l.kind='near-v2'",(fact.id,)))
  assert actual==expected
  found=fs.StatementIndex(facts).near(fact.statement,[])
  assert found is not None and found.id==fact.id
report['admitted_canonical_near_sets_and_recall_checked']=len(admitted)
singles=[]
for _ in range(20):
 t=time.perf_counter();fact,action=h.add_fact(root,statement(start),source_trace_id='single-'+str(start));singles.append((time.perf_counter()-t)*1000)
 assert action=='ADD';advance(1)
report['single_samples_ms']=singles;report['single_p95_ms']=sorted(singles)[math.ceil(len(singles)*.95)-1]
if args.profile:
 profile=cProfile.Profile();profile.enable()
 try:result=h.add_facts(root,items(start,1000))
 finally:profile.disable()
 assert len(result)==1000 and all(action=='ADD' for _,action in result);advance(1000)
 with open(args.output+'.profile.log','w') as out:pstats.Stats(profile,stream=out).strip_dirs().sort_stats('cumulative').print_stats(40)
report['after']=count();fs.close_connections(root)
report['imported_commontrace_files']={name:module.__file__ for name,module in sys.modules.items() if name.startswith('commontrace') and getattr(module,'__file__',None)}
assert all(name.startswith(args.source+'/') for name in report['imported_commontrace_files'].values())
assert all(hashlib.sha256((Path(args.source)/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected for name,expected in hashes.items())
report['runner_source']=Path(__file__).read_text();report['finished_at_unix']=time.time()
Path(args.output).write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({key:report[key] for key in ('label','source_commit','before','facts_before_timed_batch','batch','single_p95_ms','after')}),flush=True)

"""Run the unchanged exact-1M storage harness; retain a new fixture after timing."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

source = '/tmp/commontrace-write-cpu-worktree'
sys.path.insert(0, source)
from benchmarks import next_generation_storage as benchmark
from commontrace import fact_store, hierarchical

assert all(module.__file__.startswith(source + '/') for module in (benchmark, fact_store, hierarchical))
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], cwd=source)
tracked = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '-z'], cwd=source, text=True).split('\0')
hashes = {name: hashlib.sha256((Path(source) / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          for name in tracked if name and (Path(source) / name).is_file()}
provenance = {'source_root': source,
              'source_commit': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=source, text=True).strip(),
              'source_files_sha256': hashes, 'wrapper_source': Path(__file__).read_text(),
              'retention': 'Only after every original million-fact measurement sample; no API operation or write setting changed.'}
original_measure = benchmark.measure


def measure_and_retain(root, size, trials):
    measured = original_measure(root, size, trials)
    if size == 1_000_000:
        fact_store.close_connections(root)
        parent = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='commontrace-cpu-retained-million-')
        destination = os.path.join(parent, 'sqlite')
        shutil.copytree(root, destination)
        with sqlite3.connect(fact_store.database_path(destination)) as connection:
            counts = {table: connection.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ' + table).fetchone()[0]
                      for table in ('facts', 'events', 'lexicon', 'postings')}
        metadata = {**provenance, 'root': destination, 'original_temporary_root': root,
                    'counts': counts,
                    'bytes': sum(path.stat().st_size for path in Path(destination).rglob('*') if path.is_file())}
        # Preserve the previously sealed fixture and its metadata under their original names.
        Path('/tmp/commontrace-cpu-retained-million-store.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2) + '\n')
        print('Retained newly completed million-fact store:', destination, flush=True)
    return measured


benchmark.measure = measure_and_retain
try:
    exit_code = benchmark.main()
finally:
    assert all(hashlib.sha256((Path(source) / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected
               for name, expected in hashes.items())
    provenance['imported_commontrace_files'] = {name: module.__file__ for name, module in sys.modules.items()
                                               if name.startswith('commontrace') and getattr(module, '__file__', None)}
    assert all(path.startswith(source + '/') for path in provenance['imported_commontrace_files'].values())
    Path('/tmp/commontrace-write-cpu-release-provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(provenance, indent=2) + '\n')
raise SystemExit(exit_code)

"""Bind every write-CPU diagnostic and the fresh release run to frozen sources."""
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.serialization import load_pem_private_key

from benchmarks.signed_results import sign, verify, verify_artifacts

SOURCE = '7e0a22402b9e69653c2fa190a374b42b92ccb83b'
FROZEN = Path('/tmp/commontrace-write-cpu-worktree')
FOLDER = Path('docs/strategy/measurements')
files = {}
verified_sources = set()


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def gitsha(commit, path):
    return hashlib.sha256(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', commit + ':' + path])).hexdigest()


def verify_source(raw):
    commit, root = raw['source_commit'], raw['source_root']
    if (commit, root) not in verified_sources:
        for name, expected in raw['source_files_sha256'].items():
            assert sha(Path(root) / name) == expected == gitsha(commit, name), name
        verified_sources.add((commit, root))
    assert all(path.startswith(root + '/') for path in raw['imported_commontrace_files'].values())


def write(name, value):
    path = FOLDER / name
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')
    files[str(path)] = sha(path)


assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=FROZEN, text=True).strip() == SOURCE
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], cwd=FROZEN)
prototype = read('/tmp/commontrace-write-cpu-next.json')
verify_source(prototype)
assert len(prototype['rounds']) == 8
assert all(row['canonical_near_sets_and_reader_checked'] == 1000 for row in prototype['rounds'])
rounds = []

    assert raw['after']['facts'] == raw['after']['events']
    profile = Path(str(path) + '.profile.log')
    rounds.append({'label': label, 'raw_sha256': sha(path), 'raw': raw,
                   'profile': profile.read_text() if profile.exists() else None})
assert all(row['facts_per_second'] < 2000 for row in prototype['rounds'])
assert all(row['raw']['batch']['facts_per_second'] < 2000 for row in rounds)
diagnostics = {
